A Letter For You

🌸⚜️💮💐💮⚜️🌸

To my dearest Alaa, on the beginning of your twenty-second chapter. 🌸

If I could give you one thing for your birthday, I think I'd give you the ability to see yourself through my eyes, if only for a little while. Because I wish you could understand just how much beauty one person can bring into another person's world simply by being herself. I think the universe has a rather peculiar way of arranging things. It scatters people across this enormous, bewildering place, lets them wander through their own worlds, and every once in a while, it lets two paths cross. And sometimes, if you're very lucky, one of those people becomes someone you cannot imagine your world without. Someone who slowly becomes part of the way you understand life itself, and I think that's one of the rarest things a person can give another, a place where their soul can feel at home. I've always thought that some people are a little bit like magic. Not the grand, thunder and lightning sort, but the softer kind. The kind that hides in familiar, warm voices, in conversations that wander nowhere and everywhere, in the comfort of being understood without having to translate every little corner of your soul. The kind that makes an ordinary Tuesday feel like a page from an ethereal book, simply because you got to share it with someone. And how am I supposed to describe you when words have always felt too small for the magic you carry? There's something about you that feels like finding a tiny door in an otherwise ordinary wall and discovering an entire enchanted garden on the other side. A world full of feelings, little wonders, silly thoughts, and all the beautiful nonsense that makes being alive so wonderfully worthwhile. I adore how you're someone who feels things. Someone who can find an entire universe tucked inside a little moment, who can make a story out of a feeling and a feeling out of a song. I hope you never lose that part of yourself. I hope the world remains full of secret gardens for you to stumble upon, that the moon always has something to say to you May your twenty-second year be a year of lovely coincidences, handwritten-letter kind of days, unexpected flowers, songs that feel like they were written just for you, and the sort of happiness that sneaks up on you while you're busy doing something. You are, and will always be, my best friend in the truest sense of the words. Because somewhere along the way, you became the one my heart recognizes as its own. I love you, endlessly. Now go be twenty-two. Be sentimental. Fall in love. Collect pretty moments like seashells. Make wishes at 11:11. Talk to the moon if you must.
Always your friend, in this life and in every lovely little universe where we might have found each other. 🌸✨
